It is filled on a purely temporary basis for one year, with extension based on performance up to a total project tenure of 3 years. content_sections.heading: About ICMR-NIRRCH
content_sections.text: The ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women's Health, formerly known as ICMR-NIRRCH, is an Indian Council of Medical Research institute on Jehangir Merwanji Street, Parel, Mumbai 400012. This vacancy serves an ICMR-funded project study on a chemotaxis-based microfluidic sperm sorting device for ART, and the post will be based at the institute in Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice says that only candidates meeting the eligible qualifications should apply. Three Years Graduate degree in Medical Social Work plus three years post qualification experience OR Post Graduation Degree in Medical Social Work The three years of post-qualification experience is required with the three-year graduate degree route; the post-graduation route in Medical Social Work is listed as an alternative. Experience in counselling participants for recruitment in research studies. Fluent with local languages like Hindi, Marathi, as well as English. Prior experience and knowledge of clinical data collection and data entry. The age limit printed for the post is 35 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Technical Support – III (Social Worker) post carries a consolidated salary of Rs.36,400/-, made up of Rs.28,000/- plus 30% HRA. The appointment is on a purely temporary basis for one year, with further extension based on performance; the total project tenure is 3 years. The selected candidate will be deployed through the outsourcing agency M/s. G A Digital Web Word Pvt Ltd, not appointed directly.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICMR-NIRRCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy, for the post of Project Technical Support – III (Social Worker).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Social Worker post?
faq.answer: A Three Years Graduate degree in Medical Social Work plus three years post qualification experience, OR a Post Graduation Degree in Medical Social Work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit printed for the post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Technical Support – III (Social Worker)?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs.36,400/- per the notice, which is Rs.28,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: No, the 30% HRA is already included in the Rs.36,400/- consolidated salary; the base amount is Rs.28,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ICMR-NIRRCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed Bio Data format and email it to [email protected], with the Advertisement No. PTS-II/031126 in the subject line, on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications will be screened and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for a physical interaction or online interview, with details sent to them later.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary for one year, extendable based on performance up to the total project tenure of 3 years, and the deployment is through outsourcing agency M/s. G A Digital Web Word Pvt Ltd.

faq.question: Q10. Which languages are desirable for this post?
faq.answer: Fluency in local languages like Hindi, Marathi, as well as English, is listed as desirable.
